desc: Identify that the previous complex solution is incomplete/failing and switch to a simpler hub+block-cut formulation.
Refine the formulation: include all degree>=3 hub vertices and endpoint-side penalty 4 when the hub projects to the S or T endpoint articulation.
Implement the clean block-cut-tree + Suurballe solver described above and make it pass the public samples.
Optimize Tarjan, block adjacency construction, and per-block min-cost 2-flow for N,M up to 2e5.
